profile_md: Provisional (Partial) profile. Brunel's clearest employer-linked project route is Brunel Business School's Co-Innovate collaborative student projects: SMEs write briefs, students are matched under a three-party contract, work on campus with academic supervision and deliver a report; the route can serve as a final-year project (30 credits on the BSc Business Management with Entrepreneurship page), where students present recommendations to the client's management team. Sources say projects may be done individually or in a small team, so group working is Unclear, and pages are undated with ERDF funding referenced to 2020, so current delivery is unverified. Other leads: Design+ and live briefs in Brunel Design School, PG design studios with industry partners, MSc Project Management live consultancy projects, a Global Challenges BASc 8-week placement or group project (external bodies optional), and a two-week Enterprise Mobility Challenge (Feb 2025). No route is yet verified as meeting all three criteria with current delivery. Engineering, computing, science and social science areas remain unsearched.
gaps: Search limit reached; engineering/computing, science, social sciences not searched; no dated 2025/26 evidence for Co-Innovate; team-vs-individual not separable; Design+ / Digital Design group project unverified; MSc PM live-project detail missing.
